info.title: Workbox API
info.summary: Sandboxes for AI agents over REST and WebSocket.
info.description:
Create sandboxes, run commands and durable sessions in them, move files, follow events and manage keys and webhooks. This document is generated from the server's route table and request schemas.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation names the scope it needs in `x-workbox-scope` and its description; `admin` stands for every scope. Operations with `x-workbox-unbound-key` refuse a key bound to sandboxes. Operations with `x-websocket` are WebSocket upgrades. A request carrying `Origin` or `Sec-Fetch-Site`, or addressed to a Host the server does not serve, is refused with 403 before authentication.

JSON bodies are at most 8388608 bytes and are checked against the schemas here; string lengths count UTF-8 bytes. Send `x-request-id` to choose the request id that errors and logs carry.

servers.description: The server that serves this document; `workbox serve` listens on http://127.0.0.1:8790 by default.

get.description:
Attach to a session over a WebSocket: output, input, resize and signal. A plain GET is 426.

Server frames:

- `{"type": "ready", "sessionId"}` first; client frames sent before it are not read.
- `{"type": "session.output", "params": {sessionId, stream, seq, data}}`: output, `data` base64, `stream` `stdout`, `stderr` or `pty`. The session's retained output is replayed first.
- `{"type": "session.exit", "params": {sessionId, code, signal, seq, at}}` when the session exits.
- `{"type": "error", "code", "message"}` when a client frame fails; a failed attach also closes the socket with 1011.

Client frames:

- `{"type": "input", "data": "<base64>", "eof": true}`: write to stdin; `eof` is optional and closes it.
- `{"type": "resize", "rows", "cols"}`: resize a PTY session.
- `{"type": "signal", "signal": "SIGINT"}`: signal the session's process group.

Closing the socket detaches; the session keeps running.

Scope: `exec`.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the WebSocket is open.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

426.description: A plain GET without a WebSocket upgrade (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`).

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.

get.description:
This sandbox's events over a WebSocket: the stored ones after `afterSeq`, then live ones, each once and in order. A plain GET is 426.

Server frames:

- `{"type": "event", "event": {...}}`, one per event, in `seq` order.
- `{"type": "live", "seq": N}`, once, when the stream turns live: every matching event up to `N` has been sent and later ones follow as they are logged.
- `{"type": "error", "code", "message"}` before the server closes the stream with 1011.

A client that reads too slowly is dropped once 1 MiB is waiting to be sent to it; shutdown closes the stream with 1001. To resume, reconnect with `afterSeq` set to the last `seq` received, or to the `live` frame's `N` when that is greater.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: afterSeq
parameters.description: Replay the stored events after this `seq` first; without it, only new ones.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types, each exact or `prefix.*` for every type starting with `prefix.`; at most 32. May repeat.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the WebSocket is open.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

Error.description:
The error envelope. Each code answers with one status:

- 400: `E_PARSE`, `E_INVALID_PARAMS`
- 403: `E_DENIED`
- 404: `E_UNKNOWN_METHOD`, `E_NOT_FOUND`
- 409: `E_CONFLICT`, `E_BUSY`, `E_STATE`
- 413: `E_LINE_TOO_LONG`
- 416: `E_GAP`
- 423: `E_QUARANTINED`
- 429: `E_LIMIT`
- 499: `E_CANCELLED`
- 500: `E_INTERNAL`
- 501: `E_UNSUPPORTED`
- 503: `E_CLOSED`, `E_UNAVAILABLE`
- 504: `E_TIMEOUT`

A missing or invalid token is 401 `E_DENIED`, a body over the size cap 413 `E_LIMIT`, a route that exists under another method 405 `E_INVALID_PARAMS`, and an unknown path 404. The 5xx message of an error without a code is `internal error`.
